content.text: {"class": "PRODUCT_DEFECT", "reasoning": "The service throws an NPE in AccountService.mapAccount when Account.getStatus() is null, which the contract explicitly permits for PENDING_VERIFICATION accounts and says MUST NOT fail the request. The test file is unchanged since March while the regression appeared in build #2120 right after commit 7aa3e0d 'refactor: inline status mapping in mapAccount', pinpointing the product change as the cause. The test's expectation of 200 matches the documented contract, so the fault is in the application's null handling."}
